Behind him, blurred in shallow depth of field, the rival team celebrates: the mid laner has NO glasses, dyed light ash-brown undercut hair, broad shoulders and a white and teal jersey with no logos, and his teammates are blurred with varied hairstyles and no glasses. The image uses a cold blue-gray palette with dim, desaturated stage spotlights, a faint cold rim light on the protagonist, a hazy blurred audience, thin clean line art and soft cel shading in a 2D anime Ghibli/Shinkai and manhwa style.
